summary.text: Nicholas Bridle is the incumbent Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He has represented the district since December 2024 and works as a communications specialist, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Bridle was born in Exeter, New Hampshire.
He graduated from Winnacunnet High School and earned a bachelor's degree from ECPI University in 2012.
His career experience includes working as a communications specialist.
